title: Chapter 123 There Is A Traitor
content:
Chapter 123 There Is A Traitor

In the distance, Tang Sheng was seen blocking Wang Zhen alone.

Luo Ming, Yan Yan and others were suddenly a little worried.

Although they all fought side by side because of their interests.

But if Tang Sheng got into trouble now, they would suffer the most.

And the Divine Dynasty would make a big profit.

Thinking of this, Luo Ming said in a deep voice: "Go and help him alone."

Hearing this, Yan Yan was about to leave, but the old man from the Ancient Star Domain beside him said in a calm voice: "Although he is a bit boastful, he still has some strength, and just watch first."

Hearing this, everyone looked suspicious, but their bodies were very honest and did not move.

They just fought and paid attention to the battle between Tang Sheng and Wang Zhen.

At this time, Tang Sheng and Wang Zhen were fighting back and forth.

While fighting, Tang Sheng was a little surprised in his heart. He did not expect that the strength of the Divine Dynasty's generals was so strong that even the inferior generals could be on par with him.

At the same time, somewhere in the dark, Ao Qing was watching the fierce battle in front of him calmly.

This time, he had a mission.

Otherwise, he would have shown his true form of a dragon and rushed to the battlefield, showing his power.

"Tsk tsk tsk, that guy is really well hidden."

Ao Qing smiled and shook his head, then looked at Wang Zhen who was "fighting fiercely" with Tang Sheng in the distance.

Seeing this scene, Ao Qing looked a little puzzled.

He didn't understand why he had to work so hard when he could just crush him.

I don't know how long it took.

At this time, the battlefield had already undergone some subtle changes. Although the Divine Dynasty was constantly consumed by the strong men on the Tianlin Star Domain, it still continued to advance with difficulty.

However, on the Tianlin Star Domain side, Luo Ming and others secretly breathed a sigh of relief.

If this continues, the Divine Dynasty will retreat sooner or later.

Otherwise, even if the Tianlin Star Domain is taken, the Divine Dynasty will suffer heavy losses.

Just when they were daydreaming, a sudden scream suddenly sounded.

"Ah!!"

"How is it possible for you?!"

Suddenly, Luo Ming and others trembled all over, and looked in the direction of the battle between Wang Zhen and Tang Sheng.

I saw that Tang Sheng was bleeding profusely and was seriously injured by a blow!

Seeing this scene, Luo Ming and others were a little unbelievable.

What's going on? Didn't they fight back and forth just now?

At first, they didn't believe that Tang Sheng could match the generals of the Divine Dynasty, but because the battlefield was tragic, and Tang Sheng boasted a few times, gradually, they also felt that Tang Sheng was powerful.

After all, he was the most qualified to become the God of War in the God of War Star Domain.

But obviously, they were wrong.

Tang Sheng did not have the strength to match the generals of the Divine Dynasty, but Wang Zhen hid his strength.

It's really a dog!

However, before everyone could rant, Wang Zhen had already rushed towards Tang Sheng, wanting to give him a fatal blow.

Seeing this, Tang Sheng's face turned pale, and he shouted: "Come and help me!!"

Suddenly, Luo Ming and others did not hesitate any longer, and rushed towards Wang Zhen.

Boom!

The explosion of the battle sounded.

Wang Zhen alone defeated the top masters of the three star regions, and was not inferior.

At this moment, everyone present truly understood the horror of the general of the Divine Dynasty.

This is simply a monster.

In the distance, Tang Sheng hurriedly moved away from the battlefield, and then took a healing pill and began to heal his wounds.

Huh~

Feeling his body gradually recover, Tang Sheng's trembling heart gradually calmed down.

Just now, he felt the threat of death for the first time.

At that moment, his fighting spirit was shaken.

Sensing the change in his state of mind, Tang Sheng hurriedly suppressed the restless fighting spirit in his body.

At this moment, a voice suddenly sounded from a distance.

"Senior Tang!"

Hearing this, Tang Sheng suddenly opened his eyes, and when he saw the person coming, Tang Sheng frowned.

It was an elder in Tianlin Hall. He knew him, but he was not familiar with him. He only knew that the other party was with Luo Ming.

"What's wrong? You can't hold on?"

Tang Sheng said in a deep voice.

Hearing this, the elder of Tianlin Hall waved his hand, and then said worriedly: "Senior Tang, the hall master sent me to deliver the healing pill to you. The hall master and others are now trying their best to delay the army of the Divine Dynasty."

Hearing this, Tang Sheng nodded in understanding.

"Is that so."

Looking at the fragrant healing pill in the other party's hand, it was a good product at first glance. Seeing this, Tang Sheng no longer hesitated, and then took the pill and swallowed it directly.

It melted in the mouth.

Instantly, a huge amount of medicinal power continued to flow freely from the body.

However, Tang Sheng had not felt comfortable for a few seconds when he suddenly felt something wrong in his body.

"Not good!"

There's something wrong with the medicine!

Tang Sheng's face suddenly changed, and he was about to get up.

With a sound of "Puff!"

A dagger emitting divine light had already pierced his heart.

The terrifying divine power instantly tore the vitality in his body apart.

Feeling the passing of life, Tang Sheng's face was filled with strong reluctance and fear.

As the strongest man in the God of War Star Domain, the future God of War, he died in such a place today.

"I, I am not willing to accept it."

Tang Sheng said with despair.

But at this time, his consciousness was gradually blurred.

On the side, the elder of Tianlin Temple sneered: "Don't be unwilling to accept it. Being an enemy of the Divine Dynasty is a road without a future. Your future has long been determined."

Bang!

Tang Sheng fell to the ground.

In a sense, the God of War Star Domain is dead.

......

On the other side, on the battlefield.

Wang Zhen fought with Luo Ming and other three top masters.

Without the restraint of the top masters from the Tianlin Star Domain, the army of the Divine Dynasty suddenly had no obstacles.

In less than a moment, they had already attacked the border barrier.

Boom!

With a loud bang.

Countless dense cracks suddenly appeared on the entire barrier!

This is the rhythm of breaking.

Seeing this scene, Luo Ming and others looked ugly.

"Damn, Tang Sheng hasn't recovered yet?"

Luo Ming said in a deep voice.

If they don't come, their Tianlin Star Domain will be gone.

At this time, an elder of the Tianlin Palace suddenly rushed over here.

"Palace Master, I'm here to help you!"

Seeing the elder of the Tianlin Palace, Yan Yan and others looked puzzled.

For a small elder like you to participate in this level of battle, isn't it courting death?

The Lord of Tianlin Temple, Luo Ming, was puzzled and said, "Third Elder, what are you doing here? Get out of here!"

However, for some reason, the Third Elder of Tianlin Temple came to Luo Ming's side resolutely.

"Lord, I want to contribute as well."

Hearing this, Luo Ming said angrily, "You, what can you contribute?"

He smiled and said, "Take this."

A dagger appeared in his hand, and the next moment, under the unbelievable eyes of everyone, the dagger pierced Luo Ming's chest.

Swish!

In an instant, a terrifying external force surged out.

The Third Elder of Tianlin Temple was blown away directly.

"Lord Luo!"

"No, it's over!"

"Ah! Lord!"

Looking at the injured Luo Ming, everyone exclaimed.

At this time, Luo Ming's face was extremely ugly, and he also looked at the third elder who was smiling in the distance in disbelief.

"Why did you betray Tianlin Temple?"

Luo Ming said in a deep voice.

Hearing this, the third elder in the distance sneered and said: "Lord Luo, a good bird chooses a tree to live in. I think you should understand this principle."

Hearing this, Luo Ming did not speak, but turned his head to look at Wang Zhen in the distance.

"You are very cunning."

Wang Zhen did not explain this.

In fact, he did not want to betray the people on the Tianlin Star Domain. If so, it would be too simple.

After all, with the conditions of the Divine Dynasty, few people can resist the temptation.

It's a pity that he didn't bother to do so.

But what he didn't expect was that the third elder of the Tianlin Palace actually took the initiative to find him.

At first, he didn't pay attention, but later Zhou Lao said that the Tianlin Star Domain was not simple, so he agreed to the third elder of the Tianlin Palace.

After all, you have to keep a hand.
